fuxa.name: FUXA shapes
fuxa.notes: 24x24 outline shapes drawn for a dark editor: pumps, compressors, valves, tanks, exchangers, agitators. The fitter strips their white strokes.

equinor.name: Equinor engineering symbols
equinor.notes: 96x96 ISO-style P&ID symbols drawn as filled outlines, with connector annotations the fitter turns into data-port. Codes: PP pumps, PV valves, PT tanks/vessels, PA agitators, PS separators, ND nodes, IM instruments.
